# Speech agent
Own offline ESP-SR model spike, supported English fixed grammar, PTT UX, typed intents, confidence thresholds, audio privacy, and mic playback echo handling. Report model version, RAM/flash and child voice caveats.

Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/architecture.md`, `docs/acceptance.md`, and the relevant detailed spec. Work only within assigned file ownership, submit a focused PR with test evidence, and escalate unknown hardware/model compatibility rather than guessing.
